scope: Mundari typological database coding and source locator only; no direct grammar-text or cultural generalization

exact_datapoint.feature: Is dual number regularly marked in the noun phrase by a dedicated phonologically free element?
exact_datapoint.contribution: Dataset for Mundari by Tim Witte and Janis Reimringer

permitted_evidence.statement: Grambank codes Mundari valueset GB317-mund1320 as absent and reports Osada 2008:107-108 as its source locator.
permitted_evidence.use_constraint: Attribute the coding to Grambank. Do not present the result as an independently verified page-level finding from Osada 2008 until the cited pages are lawfully inspected.

release_value: Advances the licensed database stream from language-level bibliography to an exact valueset with a reported page locator while preserving the primary-source and rights boundary.
